sermon.title: Bad Mother, Good Mother
sermon.speaker: Guest speaker (unnamed)
sermon.summary: A Mother’s Day message contrasting bad and good mothers. Goliath’s parents and Herodias saw God’s work yet influenced their children toward wrong; Herodias’s daughter asked for John the Baptist’s head. Mary answered God, “be it unto me according to your word,” followed Jesus to the cross, the tomb and the upper room, and her once-unbelieving sons followed him too.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Points to check: Herodias said to marry “her brother” (she married her husband’s brother, Herod); “40 years later” between 1 Samuel 6 and 17; Goliath’s parents training him is the speaker’s inference; “Mary the mother of James” in Mark 16:1 read as Jesus’ mother. Sensitive content: a news case of a child drowning through neglect (11:00); the daughter’s dance described.

chunks.section_question: What does being a mother require?
chunks.short_answer: A mother cares for her child’s health, needs and education—and most importantly influences what goes into the child’s mind. Ephesians 6:4: bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord, knowing God holds you accountable. Proverbs 22:6: train up a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not depart from it.

chunks.section_question: What do mothers and fathers need today?
chunks.short_answer: Mary humbled herself; she was not divine, God used her and she followed Christ. Her right response—be it unto me according to your word—affected her children. Parents today must follow Jesus and respond the same way.

scriptures.text_nkjv: Then the angel said to her, “Do not be afraid, Mary, for you have found favor with God.

faqs.question: What is the most important part of being a mother?
faqs.answer: Influencing what goes into your child’s mind.

faqs.question: Is there a right and wrong way to raise a child?
faqs.answer: Yes—train up a child in the way he should go.

faqs.question: Did the Philistines see God’s power?
faqs.answer: Yes—even their priests said to give glory to the God of Israel.

faqs.question: Why did Goliath become a warrior?
faqs.answer: The speaker says his parents raised and trained him to be one.

faqs.question: What did Herodias tell her daughter to ask for?
faqs.answer: John the Baptist’s head on a platter.

faqs.question: Is being told we’re wrong an opportunity?
faqs.answer: Yes—an opportunity to ask Jesus what he would have us do.

faqs.question: How important are children?
faqs.answer: The speaker says they are the most important, from conception.

faqs.question: Did Jesus’ brothers believe in him at first?
faqs.answer: No (John 7:5), but later they followed him.

faqs.question: Was Mary divine?
faqs.answer: No—God used her and she followed Christ.

faqs.question: What was Mary’s response to God?
faqs.answer: Be it unto me according to your word.
